RagShortTexts: Pasture protection and delivered rewards support Sanatruk.
Nominal southern relations cannot replace local kin recognition.

Variants.Content: Recognition depends on pasture protection and delivered rewards. A southern court’s nominal relationship cannot replace local kin support.

Pasture protection and delivered rewards support Sanatruk. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Nominal southern relations cannot replace local kin recognition.

Nominal southern relations cannot replace local kin recognition. Nominal rights require local execution, with consent and supply both shaping authority. Pasture protection and delivered rewards support Sanatruk.

Pasture protection and delivered rewards support Sanatruk. Households judge rule through protected families, land and responses to appeals. Nominal southern relations cannot replace local kin recognition.

Nominal southern relations cannot replace local kin recognition. Arbitration and delivered promises support trading credit; distant prestige still needs local response. Pasture protection and delivered rewards support Sanatruk.
